about: What happened on each trip of the day, for the end-of-day reflection.
rules: One record per trip that departed: what happened, against the estimate the trip was chosen by (estimated_total_time_s, on empty roads). Times in seconds; departure and arrival also as HH:MM.

delay_ratio is actual_total_time_s / estimated_total_time_s. Jeepney trips also have their actual parts, as in the options: access (walking to where they flagged the jeepney), waiting, in-vehicle, egress.
full_pass_bys_experienced: full jeepneys of the line that came by while the commuter waited, or walked along the route, and could not take them.

disrupted: the trip took at least 2x its estimate and at least 10 min longer, or had not arrived when the run ended (disruption_reason says which). It is null for a trip still underway when a run stopped before the day was over (whole_day false).
distance_m and cost_php are those of the chosen option.
An agent with left_out had their whole day left out before the run, because a trip could not be made as chosen: they made no trips.
